At Gentle Dental Arlington, we provide high-quality care with modern dental technology in a convenient location. With flexible scheduling, prompt appointments, and acceptance of various insurance plans alongside affordable financing options, we make dental care stress-free for your family.

Gentle Dental Arlington has been delivering expert dental care for over 30 years. Conveniently located on Mass Ave near City Hall, our newly renovated office features calming gray and blue decor and state-of-the-art technology, including digital X-rays and electronic patient charts. This ensures a seamless, patient-centered experience.

Our dentists and specialists in Arlington offer comprehensive dental services in a comfortable, welcoming environment. We provide everything in-house, from preventive care like digital X-rays and cleanings to advanced treatments, including braces and root canals, so referrals aren't needed.

Our Gentle Dental Arlington dentists take pride in providing comprehensive dental services. Patients can feel confident in their high-quality care by staying current with the latest advances in dental care through continuing education and training. Building long-standing, trusting relationships with patients is vital to overall care at our Arlington dental office.
